newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Romania services fell 10.5 pct in September.
newsitem.headline: Romania services fell 10.5 pct in September.

text.p: Romania's September commercial services fell by 10.5 percent to 353.7 billion lei from the previous month in real terms, National Statistics Board (CNS) data showed on Tuesday.
The CNS said services in September were 0.2 percent up from the same month of 1995. Nine-month services, worth 2.62 trillion lei, were up 1.2 percent from the year-ago period.
Data refer to commercial services to the population and exclude transport, mail and telecoms.
The private sector took 73 percent of nine-month services, up from 72.2 percent in the equivalent period of 1995. -- Luli Popescu, Bucharest Newsroom 40-1 3120264
